chapters.title: Meet Otto
captions: Your agents. Your repos. Your data. Your infrastructure.
Otto: every coding agent, one native Mac app.

chapters.title: Home
captions: Home shows what needs you, what's running and what's next.
Light or dark, one design system.

chapters.title: The command bar
captions: Press ⌘K, type or speak. Otto runs it or answers.
⌥Space calls the bar from anywhere on your Mac.

chapters.title: Assistant
captions: Your personal agent keeps threads, memory and tasks.
It asks before anything leaves your Mac.

chapters.title: Agents and History
captions: Claude Code, Codex and shells run as real sessions.
Tile them, work a queue, broadcast one prompt to many.
Resume any past conversation from History.

chapters.title: Run with Otto and Mission Control
captions: Run with Otto turns a ticket into a reviewed branch.
Mission Control shows the work: running, waiting, approvals, spend.

chapters.title: Swarms and Goal Loops
captions: Swarms give agents roles, an org chart and a shared board.
Goal loops plan, execute and evaluate until the checks pass.

chapters.title: Workflows and schedules
captions: Workflows chain agents, approvals and tools.
Scheduled tasks and personal agents run on their own.

chapters.title: Git, reviews and proof
captions: A commit graph with your work in progress and PRs.
Multi-agent review, and proof packs behind every change.

chapters.title: Product and Vault
captions: Product turns stories into analysis and drafts.
The Vault links your docs into a live knowledge graph.

chapters.title: Design Hall and Skills Lab
captions: Design Hall: frames, 3D, sites and brand kits in one library.
Skills Lab evaluates and sharpens your agent skills.

chapters.title: Database Explorer
captions: MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis and ClickHouse.
Build a query visually, then read the results.

chapters.title: Connections and cloud
captions: SSH, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes, APIs and the web.
Every agent tool call goes through the MCP control plane.

chapters.title: Insights and Usage
captions: Insights turns your activity into key findings.
Usage tracks tokens, cost and machine load.

chapters.title: Rooms · collaborate and recap
captions: Start a room from a live session. The host admits who joins.
Share a screen and talk it through.
Teammates draw on the shared screen, with permission.
Hand over terminal control, and take it back at any time.
With everyone's consent, get a local recap: decisions and action items.

chapters.title: Everywhere
captions: Snip the screen, bridge Slack and Telegram, reach Otto from your phone.
Otto. All your agents, one home.
